events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The panel's title in its header; it names the panel.
props.name: title

props.description: The panel's content, which scrolls when it is taller than the panel.
props.name: children

props.description: The starting width in pixels. Defaults to 360.
props.name: defaultWidth

props.description: The starting height in pixels. Defaults to 420.
props.name: defaultHeight

props.description: The narrowest the panel resizes to, in pixels. Defaults to 240.
props.name: minWidth

props.description: The shortest the panel resizes to, in pixels. Defaults to 160.
props.name: minHeight

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen
